name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=pathfind, descriptor=to_destination); accurately reflects the function's role as the top-level destination pathfinding driver (seeds pathfind state, runs origin==dst short-circuit + directional DFS, returns best step count). No Ghidra address residue; no domain ID to preserve.
purpose: Top-level destination pathfinding driver: the path-aware sibling of fd2_init_movement_range_floodfill that seeds the pathfind state globals from the caller args, marks the origin tile, then runs the origin-equals-destination short-circuit and the direction-tracked recursive DFS, returning the shortest step count to the destination.
logic_summary: Spills the 10 cdecl args into the pathfind state globals at 0x60060..0x6017A (caller_context first, then seed_x/y/max_steps, output buffer, dst_x/y, mode_flags, tile map ptr, then map_width=tm[0]/map_height=tm[2], then primary cost-table ptr). Computes origin marker pointer = tm + ((uint16)(map_width*seed_y)+seed_x)*4 + 7 and writes max_steps into it as the starting residual. Resets current_depth=0 and best_path_length=0xFF (no-path sentinel). Calls fd2_pathfind_check_destination_save_path(seed_x,seed_y) for the origin==dst short-circuit, then fd2_pathfind_recursive_with_direction(seed_x,seed_y,max_steps,origin_ptr) for the directional DFS. Returns data_fd2_battle_pathfind_best_path_length (0xFF=unreachable, 0=origin is destination, else N steps).
signature: uint8 fd2_pathfind_to_destination(uint32 ct, uint32 sx, uint32 sy, uint32 ms, uint32 db, uint32 f1, uint32 f2, uint32 md, uint32 tm, uint32 af)

params.name: ct
params.semantics: Caller context / secondary cost-table base (binary's ESI spill, the FIRST store). Stored 32-bit into data_fd2_battle_pathfind_caller_context; the leaf step helpers read it back as the secondary cost table indexed by the primary table's secondary index. All call sites pass pCostTbl/move_cost_table.
params.reason: Short but mnemonic (cost table / context); no address residue; sibling-consistent with fd2_init_movement_range_floodfill's 'ct'. Clear given the documented semantics.

params.name: sx
params.semantics: Origin tile X (source column); low byte stored into data_fd2_battle_pathfind_floodfill_seed_x and used as the column term in origin tile-index math.
params.reason: Clear source-X abbreviation; matches caller src_x/saved_x; no residue.

params.name: sy
params.semantics: Origin tile Y (source row); low byte stored into data_fd2_battle_pathfind_floodfill_seed_y and used as the row term (multiplier in map_width*seed_y).
params.reason: Clear source-Y abbreviation; matches caller src_y/saved_y; no residue.

params.name: ms
params.semantics: Movement step budget (max_steps); low byte stored into data_fd2_battle_pathfind_floodfill_max_steps and written into the origin tile marker as the starting residual cost. Callers pass range_rem / 0x1C / range_remaining.
params.reason: Mnemonic for max_steps; no address residue; consistent with documented seed block. Acceptable Layer-2 abbreviation.

params.name: db
params.semantics: Path output buffer base; stored 32-bit into data_fd2_battle_pathfind_path_output_buffer_ptr, where the path recorders write the landed (x,y) / direction sequence. Callers pass pPathBuf / &dst_x / alloc_buf.
params.reason: Mnemonic (destination/dest buffer); no address residue; semantics fully documented. Acceptable abbreviation; not vague enough to mandate a change.

params.name: f1
params.semantics: Destination tile X (target column); low byte stored into data_fd2_battle_pathfind_dst_x, compared by check_destination_save_path against the live search position to detect arrival. Callers pass target_x / cursor_world_x / 0.
params.reason: 'f1' is opaque (no semantic cue) for what is the destination X coordinate; dst_x matches the global it feeds (data_fd2_battle_pathfind_dst_x) and the function's own purpose. Recorded only; rename applied in Stage 2.

params.name: f2
params.semantics: Destination tile Y (target row); low byte stored into data_fd2_battle_pathfind_dst_y, compared by check_destination_save_path against the live search position to detect arrival. Callers pass target_y / cursor_world_y / 0.
params.reason: 'f2' is opaque for the destination Y coordinate; dst_y matches the global it feeds (data_fd2_battle_pathfind_dst_y). Recorded only; rename applied in Stage 2.

params.name: md
params.semantics: Neighbor-step mode flags (0=standard, 1=standard+diversity tiebreak, 2=ignore-obstacles+dst-record); low byte stored into data_fd2_battle_pathfind_mode_flags. Observed values 0/1/2 across call sites.
params.reason: Mnemonic for mode; no address residue; semantics fully documented. Acceptable abbreviation.

params.name: tm
params.semantics: Battle tile map base (4-byte-per-tile map); stored 32-bit into data_fd2_battle_pathfind_battle_tile_map_ptr and used as the base for origin-tile address math; map_width=tm[0], map_height=tm[2].
params.reason: Mnemonic for tile map; no residue; sibling-consistent with floodfill's 'tm'.

params.name: af
params.semantics: Primary tile-attribute -> cost lookup table base; stored 32-bit into data_fd2_battle_pathfind_tile_cost_table_ptr. Callers pass data_fd2_tile_attribute_flags_buffer_ptr.
params.reason: Mnemonic (attribute flags); no residue; sibling-consistent with floodfill's 'af' and matches the caller-side buffer name.

returns.semantics: Shortest-path step count to the destination = data_fd2_battle_pathfind_best_path_length: 0xFF = unreachable, 0 = origin already is the destination, else N steps. (Binary XOR EAX,EAX; MOV AL,[0x60078]; neither CALL's EAX result is used.)
